details.detail: Surface detail: value, panel tone, seams, fastener rows, slat band, gear stripe, placards, grime
details.note: The flap streaks are fixed. In w26K they are now soft, short, tapering smudges, about 2 per canoe, at low contrast (z_w26K_r13_r14.png); they no longer read as ruled walkway bars. If anything they are now barely visible. The near-far value in w19A is unchanged: near flap 163/161, far skin 169/172, against KN41's 194 -> 146. That one belongs to the lighting owner and is not scored here.
Unchanged. The gap taper still holds at 2-3 px in w19A, and the hierarchy is correct.

The K-side flank is fixed. In w26K at x=600, the crown is L221 (y 305), then the flank runs 159 / 101 / 89 (y 320 / 340 / 350) against the 178 skin, which puts the mid-flank at 0.57 (r13: 0.94). That is within the photo range (_7250 near pod 0.53-0.54, _7331 0.38-0.43). w30K column x=480: flank 125 -> 96 against the 176 skin, so 0.55-0.71 (r13: 0.85-0.99). On the A side, w19A (470,350) / (515,240) read 115 / 102 against the 163 flap, so 0.70 / 0.63 (r13: 0.81 / 0.76; KN41 0.72-0.77): now a touch dark, but in the right order. The tails close round in c_canoe_side, so the duck-bill is gone. What remains: (a) the far pods are as dark as the near one (w26K pod 2 at (650,275) L88 and pod 3 at (700,230) L91), whereas _7250's second pod is 0.72 of the skin; (b) the flank is a single dark tone with a hard crease under a thin bright crown, where _7331 shows a broad lit upper flank (214-228) and then the drop.

The forward fairing is no longer a spear. It has a blunt, rounded nose (w13A, c_nacelle_left). It still starts at lathe x 1.4, right on the inlet split (x 1.3). In s13A and w13A it reads as a horn or peaked gable reaching forward to the split. In LALF _137 the hump starts about 25 % of the way along the fan cowl (lathe x about 1.75), rises as a dome, and is narrower.

details.note: The access panel is now a stadium, which is correct. But the second panel 0.56 m below is drawn at the same weight: a 0.012 tube in #a3a8ad against #959aa0. In w11A, w11K, s13A and c_nacelle_left the pair reads as a twin '8' glyph. LALF _136 / _137 and knav _9 each show one prominent round panel, so this is a step back in what the eye sees. The cowl, lip, splits and strake are unchanged and correct.
Unchanged. The w11K sunlit cowl is 206 / 201 / 173, still slightly hot against knav _9's peak of 187. The monogram is correct (c_ge_inboard_left).

The void is fixed. The w11K liner went 32/30/23 -> 62/55/51 at (330,400) / (340,450) / (350,520), against a knav _9 liner of 48-54. In w11A, (595,420) went 8 -> 25 and (600,380) 9 -> 25 (LALF _136, overcast: 31-87), so the 11A throat is still on the dark side. In c_nacelle_left, (650,400) went 25 -> 55 and (640,250) 8 -> 16, and the liner now grades. The joint rings render as broken, dotted hairlines (see Artefacts). The blades still do not read from these angles, which the camera geometry may make unavoidable.
Unchanged and correct, in inverted reading in w26K / w30K, as in _7250 / _7331.
Unchanged: the red tip light in n19A and the discharger comb in w19A.

There is no z-fighting, floating part or gap. New: the three inlet joint rings (gTube r 0.006 m, l.387) break into dotted or dashed hairlines in c_nacelle_left and w11K. This is the same failure the access-panel tube had at 9 mm in w6. The aliasing on the long hairlines in w26K is unchanged (lighting/AA).

issues.problem: The second outline 0.56 m below the main panel has the same tube width as the main panel and almost its tone, so the pair reads as an '8' or two equal hatches. The photos show one panel.
issues.fix: l.413: drop the second entry. If it is kept, make it barely visible: { c: '#adb1b5' } (about 2 % under the cowl), tube 0.007 in place of 0.012, and offset 0.70 m in place of 0.56 so it does not stack under the first.

issues.problem: The hump nose sits on the inlet split (lathe x 1.4) and peaks like a gable. In s13A and w13A it reads as a horn reaching to the split. In _137 the dome starts about a quarter of the way along the fan cowl.
issues.fix: l.447: lerp(1.4, 10.6, ...) -> lerp(1.75, 10.6, ...), and move the smooth() starts at l.450 and l.456 from 1.4 to 1.75. l.456: nose width lerp(0.35, 1, smooth(1.75, 2.6, x)). l.457: r = Math.min(w * 0.45, (top - bot) * 0.45) for the first 3 sections, so the nose is a dome rather than a ridge.

issues.problem: The 6 mm tubes (l.387) break into dotted or dashed lines at window distance.
